quizName:
Hardest Questions in Hawaii
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: You should slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where pedestrians are present, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must the driver show?
questions.explanation: Drivers must show their license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance when stopped. All three documents are required when driving a vehicle.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: On a freeway, you missed your turn or exit. What should you do?

options.text: Continue until the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue until the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your turn or exit, go to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Do not back up on a freeway shoulder—it is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield for left turn on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield for left turn on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: When towing a loaded trailer that weighs more than half the towing vehicle's weight, or weighs 3,000 pounds or more, the trailer must have:
questions.explanation: If a loaded trailer weighs more than half the towing vehicle's weight or weighs 3,000 pounds or more, it must have both brakes and breakaway protection.

questions.question: Driving ability can be harmed by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires the driver to be in good physical condition. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and being drowsy can all harm your ability to drive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Vehicles turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Vehicles turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers that vehicles turning left on a green light do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. They control traffic speed and movement. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. They control traffic speed and movement. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: All headlights on your vehicle must work properly and be correctly adjusted:

options.text: Only when driving in a city.
Only when other vehicles are nearby.

questions.explanation: Headlights are critical for safe driving at night, in rain, fog, and tunnels. They must work properly and be correctly adjusted at all times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. They control traffic speed and movement. This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry because all vehicles are the same.
Hide the fact that you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious problems so you do not embarrass your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where and how all the vehicle's controls work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where and how all the vehicle's controls work before driving.
questions.explanation: When driving an unfamiliar vehicle, spend a few minutes learning the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Have any defects fixed before you drive.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.
It makes it harder to think clearly.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. You may feel overly confident or silly. Alcohol also slows your reaction time, reduces coordination and balance, and hurts your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: You are angry after a work incident. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the highway to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
Stop at a bar for a few drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, take time to calm down before you drive. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and everyone on the road.

questions.question: You must signal for at least ____ feet before turning or changing lanes.
questions.explanation: You must signal for at least 100 feet before turning or changing lanes. Signal for a longer distance when driving at higher speeds.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that makes you take your attention away from driving, take your eyes off the road, or take your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you don't see other traffic.
Signal only if you see other traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you don't see other traffic.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from a curb. Don't skip this step even if no traffic is visible.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. You must focus fully on driving. Any other task can be a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: To turn safely, turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.
